We do CNC turning products

Precision turned parts from steel bright bars

Aditya Industries turns steel bright bars into finished components on CNC turning machines. Send us your drawing or sample and we will quote it.

Get a free quoteBack to home

What is CNC turning?

CNC turning is a machining process where a bar is held and spun in a chuck while a computer-controlled cutting tool removes material. It shapes the bar into round parts with steps, grooves, tapers and threads.

The machine follows a programmed path, so every part comes out the same. That suits both trial batches and repeat orders.

How it works

  • 1. Send your requirementShare a drawing, a sample, or the size and material you need.
  • 2. We confirm and quoteWe check the details and send you a quote.
  • 3. CNC turningYour parts are turned from steel bright bars on CNC machines.
  • 4. Check and deliverParts are checked and sent to you.
